layer: L3-BUILDER (RISK REDUCER): trade profit for DD/MAE caps
hypothesis: Proven risk legs (dd_guard, tp075) plus a NEW per-trade MAE-stop tighten the book's adverse excursion and drawdown at a measurable monthly cost. Exploratory only.
l2_status_at_prespec: ABSENT (checked 2026-09-08): no L2 output exists, no data invented. This config freezes the full L3 matrix + smoke constants; smoke runs on v38-identity alone.
smoke_base_note: Frozen v38 rank_en signals (raw, WITHOUT isoall calibration; 135 signals). Smoke-only stand-in. L2 rerun will point --signals at the L2 parquet and amend only: signals path, control-check values, mae_cap_X (rule below).

auxiliary._ref_mae_tp075_1x: Diagnostic-only 1x run (tp1=0.75 + MAE stops) used SOLELY as own-book guard reference for full_dd_tp075_mae. Excluded from the 6-branch table.

frozen_constants.mae_cap_X_note: 2.7% ~= v38-identity control-1x MAE-magnitude p50 (2.6846%; mean 2.66%, p75 3.53%, p90 5.61%, max 7.68% over 81 normal fills; probe 2026-09-08, entry_index..exit_index 5m extremes). TIGHTER than median signal-stop distance (3.58%) so it binds on most trades; min signal-stop distance 1.99% < X implies a few no-ops (counted, not hidden).

mae_stop_formula.long: applied_stop = max(original_stop, entry_limit*(1-X)); assert applied_stop < entry_limit
mae_stop_formula.short: applied_stop = min(original_stop, entry_limit*(1+X)); assert applied_stop > entry_limit
mae_stop_formula.entry_proxy: signal entry_limit (entry fill price unknown at signal time; causal, past-only). Keep TP1/TP2/holding unchanged.
mae_stop_formula.noop_rule: If original stop is already tighter than the X-stop, keep original and count as no-op.

l2_X_rule: On L2 rerun, set mae_cap_X = L2-control_1x MAE-magnitude p50 rounded to 3 decimals, frozen by config amendment BEFORE that run. In-sample threshold choice -> results stay exploratory.
dd_guard_formula: lev 0.5 while own-book 1x reference equity is >10% under trailing peak (past-only, 1-microsecond cutoff, 100.0 seed), else 1.0. Own-book per branch (NOT shared control ref).
mae_definition: Per filled trade, 5m-only proxy: LONG (min(low[entry..exit])-entry)/entry; SHORT (entry-max(high[entry..exit]))/entry; mae_frac=min(0,adverse). Magnitude=-mae_frac. Report mean/p50/p75/p90/max of magnitude. Diagnostic (uses post-entry extremes); the STOP itself is causal.
stress_path_note: execution_stress.py honors ExecutionConfig.tp1_fraction (close_fraction(fill, execution.tp1_fraction, ...), line ~128) and signal.stop_loss (line ~112); asserted at runtime. MAE-stop (stop_loss rewrite) and tp075 therefore flow into ALL 3 scenarios.

control_check_smoke.note: v38-identity control_1x tp1=0.5 normal. MUST reproduce or STOP. L2 rerun: replace with L2 reported numbers.

causal_notes: MAE-stop uses signal-time fields only (entry_limit proxy).
X chosen from full-sample MAE -> in-sample, exploratory by construction.
No maker-fill/queue claims; stop/timeout exits market-like at scenario fee; DD trade-candle-close sampled.
risk_cost_accounting: Per branch x scenario: fees, funding, monthly_geometric_net; vs control: monthly_cost_pp (control minus branch), dd_bought_pp (branch DD minus control DD, positive = shallower), mae_mean_reduction_pp, and cost ratios (monthly pp lost per DD pp bought / per MAE pp bought).
